name: Interstitial Granulomatous Dermatitis with Arthritis
aliases: Interstitial Granulomatous Dermatitis Associated with Arthritis

criteria.description: Presence of symmetrical polyarthritis or oligoarthritis predominantly affecting small and medium joints
Characteristic erythematous to violaceous plaques or linear cords on the trunk or proximal limbs
Skin biopsy showing interstitial granulomatous dermatitis with palisading histiocytes and neutrophilic debris
Exclusion of other granulomatous dermatoses such as granuloma annulare or rheumatoid nodules

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic cutaneous lesions with compatible histopathology and associated arthritis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on clinical presentation and histopathological confirmation; no validated diagnostic scoring system exists.

laboratory: Mildly elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) and C-reactive protein (CRP)
Negative rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP antibodies in many cases
Normal or mildly elevated white blood cell count
imaging: X-rays may show soft tissue swelling without erosions in early disease
Ultrasound or MRI may demonstrate synovitis in affected joints
other: Skin biopsy demonstrating interstitial granulomatous dermatitis with palisading histiocytes and neutrophilic debris is diagnostic

distinguishingFeatures: Granuloma annulare typically presents with localized annular plaques without arthritis
Histopathology shows necrobiotic granulomas without interstitial pattern
Rheumatoid arthritis usually has positive rheumatoid factor or anti-CCP antibodies
Skin lesions differ and rheumatoid nodules histologically distinct
History of drug exposure preceding lesion onset

redFlags: Systemic vasculitis signs such as purpura or organ involvement
Unexplained constitutional symptoms with weight loss
references: Kremer JM, et al. Interstitial granulomatous dermatitis with arthritis: clinical and histopathologic features. J Rheumatol. 1993;20(4):698-703.
Dabski K, Winkelmann RK. Interstitial granulomatous dermatitis with arthritis. Arch Dermatol. 1994;130(5):561-566.
Orphanet: Interstitial granulomatous dermatitis with arthritis. ORPHA:79099.
